zoom4.method: Absolute Rec.709 sRGB luma delta /255; changed pixels >=0.12, visible >=20% full native sprite box. Full scene versus all villagers and their shadows removed; y-sort/object/HUD occlusion retained. Mean contrast uses only opaque texels attributed to that villager by a y-sorted ID mask; nonvillager sprites and HUD clear attribution. Fully hidden villagers have zero mean and attributed_pixel_count=0. Separate box_mean fields preserve full-box values. Underlay is the complete villagers-removed scene, including ground and objects.

layout_method: Manually read concept arrangements; preserve relative hut/storage/frame/river/forest positions on native world grid.
clothing_variation: Attempted -1/0/+1 degree hue using low-saturation central lower-torso proxy; may include skin. Neutral pixels and integer RGB rounding can be no-ops. Not a verified garment segmentation.
tile_border_exception: Continuous river/shore geometry crosses tiles; local grass, earth marks and water glints stay inside borders.
